description: This file contains the AutoFilter class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, responsible for writing auto filter configurations to an Excel XLSX file, including filter columns and rules.

classes.name: AutoFilter
classes.description: Handles writing auto filter configurations to an XLSX file, including filter ranges, columns, and rules.

methods.name: writeAutoFilter
methods.description: Writes the auto filter configuration for a worksheet, including range and columns.

methods.name: writeAutoFilterColumn
methods.description: Writes the XML for a filter column and its rules.

methods.name: writeAutoFilterColumnRule
methods.description: Writes the XML for a specific filter rule within a filter column.
